scanNote: TEKSHIRILDI (skan 44-bet): Ex.14 ranglar 10 ta (brown, white, grey, pink, green, yellow, black, blue, purple, red) va o'lchamlar 7 ta skan bilan mos; rasmlar A=sigir, B=to'tiqush, C=it, D=zebra. Ex.15 jadval tartibi (geese / mouse / ox / sheep / deer / fish) va ro'yxat 6 so'z mos; qo'shimcha savol man-woman-child-person. Ex.16 rasmlari: 1=sichqon, 2=baliq, 3=kiyik, 4=g'oz, 5=qo'y, 6=tovuq - JSON bilan mos. Ex.17 o'yin ro'yxati 19 so'z - skan bilan bir xil. Xato topilmadi.

exercises.explanationUz:
RANGLAR (kitobdagi 10 ta):
  brown  — jigarrang      white  — oq
  grey   — kulrang        pink   — pushti
  green  — yashil         yellow — sariq
  black  — qora           blue   — ko'k
  purple — binafsha       red    — qizil

O'LCHAMLAR (kitobdagi 7 ta):
  KATTALIK:  very big (juda katta) > quite big (ancha katta) > small (kichik)
  UZUNLIK:   very long (juda uzun) > quite long (ancha uzun)
             > quite short (ancha kalta) > short (kalta)

DIQQAT — 'very' va 'quite' farqi:
  very  = juda   (kuchli daraja)
  quite = ancha, ancha-muncha (o'rtacha daraja)
Ikkalasi ham sifat OLDIDA turadi: very big, quite long.

exercises.instructionEn: Then read the examples. Finally, in pairs, ask and answer questions about the animals, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng namunalarni o'qing. Nihoyat, juftlikda hayvonlar haqida namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA — A rasm (sigir):

DIQQAT — 'is' yoki 'are'?
  How long is its TAIL?  → bitta narsa → IS → It's ...
  How long are its EARS? → ikkita narsa → ARE → They're ...

RANG SAVOLI: 'What colour is it?' ('What color' — amerikacha yozilishi)

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions about the animals (B, C, D), as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda B, C, D rasmlardagi hayvonlar haqida namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMLAR:
  A — jigarrang sigir (kitobdagi namuna)
  B — qizil to'tiqush (qanotida sariq, ko'k va qora patlar bor)
  C — jigarrang-oq it (o'tirgan)
  D — qora-oq zebra

Har bir hayvon uchun 4 savol: nomi, rangi, kattaligi, dumi.

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
B rasmda to'tiqush — 41-betda ham ko'rgansiz.

Tanasi qizil; qanotida sariq, ko'k va qora patlar ham bor.
To'liqroq javob: 'It's red, yellow, blue and black.'
To'tiqush sigirga nisbatan juda kichik.

items.textEn: B — How long is its tail?
items.hintUz: Rasmda dumi shoxdan pastga osilib turibdi
items.whyUz: To'tiqushning dumi tanasidan ham uzun — 'very long'.
C rasmda it.
Rasmda itning tanasi jigarrang-kulrang, bo'yni va oyoqlari oq.
It sigirdan va zebradan ancha kichik.

items.textEn: C — How long is its tail?
items.whyUz: Rasmda itning dumi ingichka va ancha uzun.

items.textEn: C — How long are its ears?
items.whyUz: Quloqlari kalta va bukilgan. Ko'plik → THEY'RE.
D rasmda zebra.
Zebra qora va oq chiziqli.
Zebra katta hayvon, lekin sigirdek 'very big' emas.

items.textEn: D — How long is its tail?
items.whyUz: Zebraning dumi ancha uzun, uchida qora tuki bor.

items.textEn: D — How long are its ears?
items.whyUz: Zebraning quloqlari uzun va tik. Sigirning quloqlaridan uzunroq.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the table with words from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: deer, fish, goose, mice, oxen, sheep

NOTO'G'RI OTLAR — ko'pligi -s bilan yasalmaydi.

IKKI TURI BOR:
  1) O'ZAK O'ZGARADI:
       goose → geese   (g'oz → g'ozlar)
       mouse → mice    (sichqon → sichqonlar)
       ox    → oxen    (ho'kiz → ho'kizlar)
  2) SHAKL O'ZGARMAYDI:
       sheep → sheep   (qo'y → qo'ylar)
       deer  → deer    (kiyik → kiyiklar)
       fish  → fish    (baliq → baliqlar)

JADVAL:
  SINGULAR (birlik) | PLURAL (ko'plik)
  .........         | geese
  mouse             | .........
  ox                | .........
  .........         | sheep
  deer              | .........
  .........         | fish

items.hintUz: Suvda suzadigan katta oq uy qushi
items.whyUz:
goose → geese. O'zakdagi 'oo' → 'ee' ga o'zgaradi.
Talaffuz: goose /ɡuːs/, geese /ɡiːs/.

mouse → mice. 'mouses' XATO.
Talaffuz: mouse /maʊs/, mice /maɪs/.
DIQQAT: kompyuter sichqonchasi uchun 'mouses' ham ishlatiladi.

ox → oxen. -EN qo'shimchasi bilan ko'plik — juda kam uchraydi.
'children' ham shu turdan.

sheep → sheep. Shakl O'ZGARMAYDI.
'One sheep, ten sheep' — bir xil.
deer → deer. 'deers' XATO. 43-betda yo'lbars 'deer' yeydi.

fish → fish. Shakl o'zgarmaydi.
DIQQAT: 'fishes' — turli TURLARI haqida gapirilganda ishlatiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: What are the plurals of these words?
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu to'rttasi — eng ko'p ishlatiladigan noto'g'ri otlar.
Har birini yod olish shart.

items.whyUz:
man → men. Talaffuz: man /mæn/, men /men/.
'mans' XATO.

items.hintUz: Yozilishi bitta harf o'zgaradi, talaffuzi ko'proq
items.whyUz:
woman → women. YOZILISHI: a → e (ikkinchi bo'g'inda).
LEKIN TALAFFUZI birinchi bo'g'inda o'zgaradi:
  woman /ˈwʊmən/ — 'vumen'
  women /ˈwɪmɪn/ — 'vimin'

child → children. 'childs' XATO.
'oxen' kabi -EN bilan tugaydi.

person → people. O'zak BUTUNLAY o'zgaradi.
'persons' ham bor, lekin faqat rasmiy hujjatlarda.
'people' — DOIM ko'plik: 'people ARE' ('people is' XATO).

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions about the animals below, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda quyidagi hayvonlar haqida namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: What is this animal?
  SB: It's a mouse. Have mice got wings?
  SA: No, mice haven't got wings.

DIQQAT — BIRLIKDAN KO'PLIKKA O'TISH:
  Rasmda BITTA hayvon → 'It's a mouse.'
  Savol esa umuman TURI haqida → 'Have MICE got wings?'

SAVOL SHAKLLARI:
  have/got  → HAVE + ko'plik ega + GOT ... ?
              Javob: No, ... haven't got ...
  can       → CAN + ko'plik ega + fe'l ... ?
              Javob: No, ... can't ...

BARCHA JAVOBLAR INKOR — chunki har bir savol
noto'g'ri xususiyat haqida so'raydi.

items.question: Have mice got wings?
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. Sichqonda qanot yo'q — u sutemizuvchi.
Ko'pligi: mouse → MICE.

items.question: Can fish run?
items.whyUz:
Baliqning oyog'i yo'q — suzadi, yugurmaydi.
Ko'pligi: fish → FISH (o'zgarmaydi).

items.question: Have deer got short legs?
items.answer: No, deer haven't got short legs. They've got long legs.
items.whyUz:
Kiyikning oyoqlari UZUN — shuning uchun tez yuguradi.
Ko'pligi: deer → DEER (o'zgarmaydi).

items.question: Have geese got whiskers?
items.whyUz:
'whiskers' (mo'ylov) faqat mushuksimonlar va ba'zi sutemizuvchilarda bo'ladi.
G'oz — qush, unda pat bor.
Ko'pligi: goose → GEESE.

items.question: Can sheep fly?
items.whyUz:
Qo'y — sutemizuvchi, qanoti yo'q.
Ko'pligi: sheep → SHEEP (o'zgarmaydi).

items.question: Have hens got fur?
items.answer: No, hens haven't got fur. They've got feathers.
items.whyUz:
Tovuq — qush. Qushda JUN emas, PAT bo'ladi.
DIQQAT: 'hen' — TO'G'RI ot, ko'pligi oddiy: hen → HENS.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoa bo'lib ishlang. Navbatma-navbat ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab, gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko. Eng ko'p ochko to'plagan jamoa g'olib bo'ladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'YIN SO'ZLARI (19 ta) — butun 6-unit lug'ati:
  fur, skin, wings, weigh, intelligent, feathers, what,
  pouch, reptiles, mammals, insects, paws, feed, where,
  sharp claws, trunk, whiskers, how big, how long

QOIDALAR:
  • Ikki jamoaga bo'linasiz
  • Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'z tanlaysiz
  • O'sha so'z bilan TO'G'RI gap tuzasiz
  • Har bir to'g'ri gap — 1 ochko
  • Ko'p ochkoli jamoa g'olib

Quyida har bir so'z uchun namuna gap berilgan.

modelSentences.sentence: Tigers have got orange fur with black stripes.
Penguins have got small wings, but they can't fly.
Penguins have got thick feathers to keep them warm.
What is this animal? — It's a kangaroo.
Kangaroos carry their babies in a pouch.
Dolphins, koalas and kangaroos are mammals.
Mammals feed their babies on milk.
Where do koalas live? — In eastern Australia.
Koalas have got very sharp claws.
An elephant's trunk is about 3.1 metres long.
Tigers and cats have got whiskers.
How big is it? — It's very big.
How long is its tail? — It's very long.

groups.explanationUz: Bu otlarning ko'pligida unli yoki butun so'z o'zgaradi.
Birlik va ko'plik bir xil yoziladi. Fe'ldan farqlanadi.
Sifatning kuchini oshiradi. Sifat OLDIDA turadi.
Ikki rang 'and' bilan bog'lanadi; tartib odatda o'zgarmaydi.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Rang, o'lcham va noto'g'ri ko'plik qoliplari.

patterns.formula: What colour is it? — It's + rang.
patterns.exampleEn: What colour is it? — It's brown.
patterns.explanationUz: Rang sifat — artikl KERAK EMAS: 'It's A brown' XATO.

patterns.formula: How big is it? — It's very/quite + sifat.
patterns.exampleEn: How big is it? — It's very big.
patterns.exampleUz: U qanchalik katta? — U juda katta.

patterns.formula: How long IS its tail? — IT'S ... / How long ARE its ears? — THEY'RE ...
patterns.exampleEn: How long is its tail? — It's very long. How long are its ears? — They're quite short.
patterns.exampleUz: Dumi qancha uzun? — U juda uzun. Quloqlari qancha uzun? — Ular ancha kalta.
patterns.explanationUz:
BITTA narsa → IS / IT'S.  IKKITA narsa → ARE / THEY'RE.
Bu eng ko'p xato qilinadigan joy.

patterns.formula: HAVE + ko'plik ega + GOT + ot? — No, ... haven't got ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Have mice got wings? — No, mice haven't got wings.
patterns.exampleUz: Sichqonlarning qanoti bormi? — Yo'q, sichqonlarning qanoti yo'q.

patterns.formula: CAN + ko'plik ega + fe'l? — No, ... can't + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Can sheep fly? — No, sheep can't fly.
patterns.exampleUz: Qo'ylar ucha oladimi? — Yo'q, qo'ylar ucha olmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'can' hech qachon -s olmaydi va undan keyin fe'l asos shaklida.

patterns.formula: It's a + BIRLIK. ... Have + KO'PLIK + got ...?
patterns.exampleEn: It's a mouse. Have mice got wings?
patterns.explanationUz:
Rasmdagi BITTA hayvon → birlik.
Butun TUR haqidagi savol → ko'plik.
